exposure: Anterior wall adhesion after cesarean section
Lateral approach technique for laparoscopic-assisted vaginal hysterectomy (LAVH)
anterior wall adherence after cesarean section
cohort: 47 women with anterior wall adhesion after cesarean section who underwent LAVH
finding: The lateral approach technique for laparoscopic-assisted vaginal hysterectomy (LAVH) is effective in women with anterior wall adhesion after cesarean section, with acceptable operating times, blood loss, and complication rates.
